Name: Shardust's Fences Gate Flooring for Alternative Textures
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][size=5]This is a port of my CP mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2790]Shardust's Fences Gate Flooring[/url]﻿
for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ framework.[/size]
[size=3]
With Alternative Textures, you can use the same object in different colors at the same time, like having the Crystal Path be Topaz, Ruby and Sapphire depending on where it leads to, or the Hardwood fences each representing the garden section they are closing off (Amethyst for Grapes, Honey for Bee Houses, etc).[/size]

Some CP options were omitted due to AT's own framework limitations, so [b]no vines, no flowers, no winter overlay[/b].
The hedges have been split from the main file and made into their own mod download due to the sheer number of new textures added.


[size=3]The objects that were retextured and/or recolored are:
Wood Fence, Stone Fence, Iron Fence, Hardwood Fence, Wood Floor, Rustic Plank Floor, Straw Floor, Weathered Floor, Crystal Floor, Stone Floor, Stone Walkway Floor, Brick Floor, Wood Path, Gravel Path, Cobblestone Path, Stepping Stone Path, Crystal Path, Gate, Hedges

The colors available for each item are:
Amethyst, Aquamarine, Ash, Blackberry, Coal, Cocoa, Cream, Diamond, Emerald, Honey, Mahogany, Mocha, Oak, Olive, Ruby, Rust, Saffron, Sapphire, Spinel, Steel, Topaz, Umber, Walnut, Wine.[/size]
[size=5]
[b]Thank you for checking out my mods![/b]

-Shardust[/size]
[/center]
